correctness.rationale: For all integers p,q>=2 and all real t>0, positive weights preserve the graphical normal fan. The p!(p+1)^q orientations have a bijection with a uniform clique permutation and independent uniform gaps. Exact total-covariance calculations give the clique, independent and axial eigenvalues and multiplicities, with one zero direction. Strict monotonicity of the clique eigenvalue and exact sign comparisons at t=0 establish the two possible crossings and the cutoff T(p); the fixed independent and axial eigenvalues establish the universal condition-number lower bound. Exact finite checks cover 36 covariance cases with 1,344 rational matrix entries, 83,400 sampled vertices counted across cases, 24 independently deduplicated total-order cases and 35,164 integer parameter comparisons. Finite checks are corroboration, not an infinite proof.

value.rationale: A complete polytope vertex-inertia classification with a sharp continuous edge-weight optimization law for an infinite two-parameter family. The nondegenerate flat interval of optimal covariance conditioning and its disappearance when q reaches an explicit aspect-ratio threshold expose a structural limitation of metric tuning not encoded by the normal fan or by earlier inradius/volume formulas. This distinguishes fixed covariance modes from the sole moving clique-contrast mode and has a natural application to preconditioning convex-body vertex sampling.
